name: Remove Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from CSV Files with OpenAI
description: Converted from the n8n template "Remove Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from CSV Files with OpenAI".

inputs.system: Analyze the provided tabular data and identify the columns that contain personally identifiable information (PII). Return only the column names that contain PII, separated by commas. Key name: 'content'. Do not include any additional text or explanation.

source.path: PDF_and_Document_Processing/Remove Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from CSV Files with OpenAI.json

setup: "Google Drive Trigger": after import, register the googlesuper webhook (`cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper`, then `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER`) and set webhookEndpointId, connectedAccountId on the trigger node.
Setup value driveFolderId: Drive Folder id (for example 1AbC...xyz). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.

hints: "Google Drive Trigger" is a provider webhook (googlesuper/GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER). Create the endpoint and trigger instance, then paste the we_… id and connected account into this node before the first run: `cdecli webhook endpoint create -c googlesuper --client-id <id>`, `cdecli webhook endpoint set-data <we_id> --signing-secret <secret>`, `cdecli trigger instance upsert --slug GOOGLESUPER_FILE_CREATED_TRIGGER --account <connectedAccountId>`.
"Extract from File" (extractFromFile.csv): Files flow as text or base64 fields on Yantra, not binary attachments; check the previous step hands over the file content.
"Merge" merged two branches; NodeSync waits for both inputs and exposes them as data1/data2 (the original merge mode was append).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Remove PII from CSV Files
This workflow monitors a Google Drive folder for new CSV files, identifies and removes PII columns using OpenAI, and uploads the sanitized file back to the drive. It requires Google Drive and OpenAI integrations with API access enabled.
